name: build-game
description: From an idea to a finished browser game: design document and playtest scenarios, (approval), build, web-console and playtest gates with a fix loop, independent playtest with real input and screenshots, polish, final gates, how-to-play README.

idea.description: The game: genre, theme, what the player does, anything that must be in it.

tech.default: Canvas 2D unless the idea needs 3D; Three.js (vendored) for 3D

approval.description: "manual" to approve the design before building, "auto" to go straight on

design.title: Game design

approve-design.title: Approve the design
approve-design.message:
The design is ready. Approve to build, or send it back with what to change.

{{state.design}}

build.title: Build & play
build.prompt: Build the game in docs/game-design.md (index.html at the workspace root). Tech: {{input.tech}}. Keep playtest.json passing (extend it if you add features; never weaken a scenario to make it pass). Play it with the browser tool and look at the screenshots as you go.

fix.title: Fix
fix.prompt:
The checks failed. Fix the game (change a playtest scenario only if the scenario itself is wrong, and say why). Re-check with the browser tool.

{{feedback}}

playtest.title: Independent playtest
playtest.prompt:
Playtest the game against docs/game-design.md and write docs/playtest-report.md.

<idea>
{{input.idea}}
</idea>

polish.title: Address the playtest
polish.prompt:
Address every BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/playtest-report.md; add a playtest.json scenario for each bug you fix so it stays fixed. Play it again to confirm, and add a "Resolution" line under each finding.

{{state.playtest}}

fix-final.title: Fix
fix-final.prompt:
The checks failed after the polish round. Fix it.

{{feedback}}

replay.title: Second playtest
replay.prompt: Second playtest: confirm each BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/playtest-report.md is resolved and nothing new broke. Append a "Round 2" section.

polish-2.title: Final fixes
polish-2.prompt:
Fix the findings in the "Round 2" section of docs/playtest-report.md, with playtest scenarios.

{{state.replay}}

docs.title: How to play
docs.prompt: Write README.md: what the game is, how to open it (open index.html, or serve the folder: npx http-server .), controls, rules and scoring, URL options (?seed, ?autostart), how to run the playtests, and known limitations from docs/playtest-report.md. Report its first paragraph.
